title.narrative: Enhancing ICT for teachers and digital tranformation of Cambodia's education

description.narrative: The use of digital technologies is rapidly growing in all spheres of life and the implications for education systems are significant. The effective integration of digital technology has the potential to address challenges in Cambodia’s education systems, as well as transform the teaching and learning experience for learners. For example, when used safely and effectively, generative AI can be used to adapt educational content to suit individual learning interests, pace and abilities to provide a dynamic and personalised learning experience and caters to diverse learning needs. The new government’s Pentagonal Strategy places a strong emphasis on digital transformation across government ministries and have strengthened the focus on the integration of technology in education and the development of digital skills and competencies. This requires a coherent approach to ensure that ICT is sustainably and equitably integrated in the sector and that teachers are well prepared. This programme will support the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS) in conducting research on the use of Generative AI, developing the ethical framework to guide any new initiatives in this area and inform continuous professional development (CPD) offerings for teachers and teacher educators in the area of ICT. This work will complement the funding UNESCO Phnom Penh is managing as Grant Agent for the GPE System Transformation Grant, in which one component is focused on ICT and digital transformation in Education.
